title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber I Cap. 1 tip)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Tip: Liber I Cap. 1 De Theologiae definitione.
blurb: Ludwig Crocius — opening of Book I On the Nature of Sacred Theology from the 1636 Bremen Latin. Tip covers Cap. 1 definition, name-scholion, and the sacred/practical opening only; the rest of the Syntagma remains.
era_note: Crocius wrote in the early seventeenth century as Reformed professor at the illustrious school of Bremen. This is not a patristic work. It is a public-domain Latin Reformed retrieval on the same Fathers-site pipeline. The 1636 Villerian folio is Public Domain Mark 1.0. Do not treat the site as ante-Nicene only.
first_english_note: No complete public-domain English of this 1636 Latin Syntagma was locked as reading text. This is a new rendering from locked Latin for the Liber I Cap. 1 tip only.

text_history.method: English follows the locked 1636 Bremen Latin of Liber I Cap. 1 tip (definition + name-scholion + sacred/practical opening), reconstructed from SLUB Dresden page images (PHYS 121-128). The same-page OCR was used as a check of the reconstruction. No modern English was copied. No Internet Archive copy was located.
